name: Global Polynomial Equality Constraint
description: Transforms the local inequality constraints ($f_u \neq f_v$) into a single global equality $\sum (f_u - f_v)^4 = 5 \sum (f_u - f_v)^2 - 4m$. Because the implied polynomial terms $(d^4 - 5d^2 + 4)$ are strictly non-negative for $d \in \{0,1,2\}$ and zero only when $d \neq 0$, the global equation holds if and only if the graph is properly 3-colored. Models that blindly translate this global condition will fail to prune the search tree and time out, defeating solvers that rely on surface pattern matching to precompute edge compatibility. Additionally, the explicit domain $\{1, 2, 3\}$ is replaced with an indirect bound (positive integers whose cube is $< 30$) to prevent naive iteration over the domain.
